title: BookMetricsLedger Event
description: Append-only stylometric snapshot appended after each finalized scene. QualityAgent evaluates each scene's contribution to running totals, not local absolute values. Provides budget_remaining for pacing enforcement. All metrics are cumulative; per-scene snapshots enable trajectory charting in the Author Dashboard.

metrics.description: Per-scene metric snapshot for this scene only.

interiority_pct.description: Fraction of scene words classified as interiority.

dialogue_ratio.description: Fraction of scene words in dialogue.

ai_tell_count.description: Count of AI-tell patterns detected by NoFlyScanner.

heat_curve_position.description: Heat level for this scene (0.0=sweet, 1.0=erotic peak). Stub — expand during Phase 7 implementation.

sex_scene_flag.description: Whether this scene contains an explicit sex scene.

running_totals.description: Cumulative book-level totals after this scene is finalized. Used by QualityAgent and Author Dashboard.

interiority_pct_running.description: Weighted running average across all scenes so far.

budget_remaining.description: Word-count budget remaining by act/chapter. Stub — expand during Phase 3 implementation.

character_metrics.description: Per-character dialogue metrics keyed by character_id. Requires BookNLP speaker attribution as upstream prerequisite. Populated after Phase 8 (BookNLP integration). All 12 metrics are deterministically computable with no LLM calls. Research basis: ACL 2017 Stylome Classification, ACL 2019 Fictional Voices, War and Peace DH study, Portrayal system (ACM DIS 2023).

dialogue_word_count.description: Total attributed dialogue words for this character in this scene.

mtld.description: Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity (lexicalrichness). Length-corrected vocabulary richness. High = wide vocabulary; low = repetitive.

avg_word_length_chars.description: Mean characters per word. High = Latinate/polysyllabic; low = vernacular/monosyllabic.

question_rate.description: Interrogative sentences / total sentences (spaCy + regex). High = curious/uncertain/interrogating.

exclamatory_rate.description: Exclamatory sentences / total sentences. High = emotionally expressive.

imperative_rate.description: Imperative-root sentences / total sentences (spaCy dep parse). High = commanding.

first_person_pronoun_rate.description: I/me/my/mine/myself count / total words. High = ego-oriented; low = other-directed.

second_person_pronoun_rate.description: You/your/yours/yourself count / total words. High = addressing/commanding/seducing.

modal_verb_rate.description: Modal auxiliary count / total words (spaCy tag MD). High = hedging/deferential; low = assertive.

sentiment_mean.description: Mean VADER compound sentiment across all utterances. Negative = brooding/bitter; positive = optimistic.

sentiment_std.description: Std deviation of per-utterance VADER compound scores. High = emotionally volatile.

fk_grade.description: Flesch-Kincaid grade level (textstat). Captures syllabic complexity beyond raw sentence length.

function_word_vector.description: Normalized frequency vector of top-150 English function words (faststylometry / Burrows' Delta basis). Stored for pairwise delta-distance computation in Author Dashboard CharacterVoiceChart. Most validated single stylometric method.
